name: Yamamoto Rurika
source:
Rurika lives in Nagoya (名古屋), Aichi and goes to Mizutsuka High School (水塚高校) where she is a third year student in class A.

There isn't any one thing she's interested in, but she likes to have fun. She works part-time at a convenience store.
